metadata.description: ELEVATE 2026 — release-level documentation reconciliation, sprint hygiene, and PR-to-board status sync agents.

plugins.name: release-reconciler
plugins.description: Reconciles documentation against everything shipped since the last release tag. Opens one gated PR with a doc-debt ledger. Also generates Docs/DOMAIN.md — a business-facing domain knowledge doc covering user roles, business rules, and user flows, for new users and product owners.

plugins.name: jira-sprint-nudge
plugins.description: Scans the current sprint and rates every issue's description for clarity (1-5), not just presence — flags vague, too-short, and self-contradictory descriptions, then asks the reporter for specific fixes. Re-scores whenever a description changes: acknowledges real fixes, re-nudges if still weak, stays silent otherwise.

plugins.name: jira-pr-sync
plugins.description: Moves Jira issues along the board based on GitHub PR lifecycle events, using the Jira ID prefix in commit messages. Only transitions an issue if it's currently in the exact expected starting status, so manual moves are never overridden.
